general_information.Description: The Captone Project is a combination of theory, practice, application, and attitudes accompany the construction of each course. Students can work in groups, with a significant project experience in which they can integrate much of the materials they have learned in their program. The project is recommeded to be as realistic as possible. Furthermore, the project may take various forms (e.g., written thesis, applied design project, simulation project or software program) based on the specific discipline. There are several paths that student can select to do the capstone projects: - Electronics and Embedded Systems - Wireles and Mobile Communications - Optical Communications - Networking
general_information.StudentTasks: # Choose project at project market and form group. # Divide and schedule work among members # Attend all scheduled meeting with supervisor. # Produce document and product according to project requirement and member work share. # Defence work infront of examination board, showing both project results and individual responsibility.
general_information.Tools: Tools: Appropriate tools for design and implementation.

assessments.Grading Guide: • Based on Group Mark (GM). Each group on every stage (with report) will be evaluated by its supervisor. This evaluation is called continuous assessment. • Personal Mark (in range: from 0% to 120%GM) will also be given for all Reports or all continuous assessment. • On-going Criteria: Yes (after 6 weeks: 4 reports >=5) and • On-going assessment >=5/10
assessments.Note: 50% of Final CP Mark with weight (On-going assessment) - Report No. 1: 5% - Report No. 2: 10% - Report No. 3: 15% - Report No. 4: 25% - Report No. 5: 40% - Report No. 6: 5%

assessments.Grading Guide: • Presentation mark is given by each member of referee committee for each student on final project presentation. This personal mark is the average of all member of referee committee.
assessments.Note: • Final Project Result = On-going assessment (6 Reports) x 50% + Defense Mark (by Committee) x 50%
